# Draft:Precision: The Child Drug Trafficking

Precision: The Child Drug Trafficking is a 2017 Ugandan Action Crime thriller film. It was written by Sserunya Ernest, co-produced by Sserunya Ernest and Jonas Wolcher and directed by Sserunya Ernest. The film tells the spotlights on the issue of crime, drug abuse and trafficking among urban and low income communities.
Plot
The plot is about an American named Duke Riley, who comes to Kampala to visit his brother, Paul. On arrival, Duke is attacked by street kids who made away with his luggage. In an attempt to recover his stolen items, the kids tricked him into the territory of a notorious gang leader named Tumalata. Duke is in trouble, and his only means of escape is to fight the gang leader.
